name: Outpath Solutions Smart Image Optimizer
author: outpathsolutions

sections.description:
Smart Image Optimizer automatically optimizes every image you upload to WordPress — no external API, no monthly limits, no configuration required. Everything runs server-side using PHP’s built-in GD and Imagick libraries.

What it does

  • Converts JPEG, PNG and GIF images to WebP and/or AVIF on upload
  • Smart Compare: if the converted file is larger than the original, it is automatically discarded
  • Strips EXIF metadata (GPS coordinates, camera info) for privacy and smaller file sizes
  • Scales images that exceed a configurable maximum width
  • Converts static GIFs to WebP (animated GIFs are skipped automatically)
  • Works with CDN setups via an optional CDN URL setting
  • Background queue processing — uploads stay fast even with large images
  • Detailed stats dashboard showing bytes saved, files converted and load time improvements
  • Bulk optimize tool to convert your existing media library

No API key required

Unlike many image optimization plugins, Smart Image Optimizer runs entirely on your own server using PHP’s GD and Imagick extensions. No account, no external service, no usage limits.

Pro version — AI-powered features

The Pro version adds AI-powered image management via the Anthropic API (your own key):

  • Image Recognition — detects people, places and objects in every photo
  • Alt Text Generator — generates accurate alt text with one click
  • SEO Filenames — suggests keyword-rich filenames based on image content
  • Caption Generator — generates captions and product descriptions from images

Learn more about Smart Image Optimizer Pro
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Go to Image Optimizer → Settings to configure formats, quality and options
  4. Go to Image Optimizer → Bulk Optimize to convert your existing media library

New uploads are optimized automatically after activation.
sections.faq:
Will my original images be deleted?

No. The plugin creates additional WebP/AVIF files alongside your originals. Originals are never deleted unless you explicitly disable the “Keep Originals” option.

What if the WebP file is larger than the original?

Smart Compare is enabled by default. If a converted file is larger than the original, the plugin automatically discards it and keeps the original.

Does it work with my CDN?

Yes. The plugin detects WebP/AVIF files from the filesystem rather than URL matching. An optional CDN URL setting is available in the settings page.

Does it require GD or Imagick?

The plugin uses Imagick when available and falls back to GD. Both are standard PHP extensions included in most hosting environments.

Does it support AVIF?

Yes, AVIF conversion is supported when your server has Imagick with AVIF support (Imagick 7.0.25+ with libheif). The plugin detects support automatically and falls back to WebP if AVIF is unavailable.

Does it work with multisite?

Yes, the plugin is compatible with WordPress multisite installations.
